title: Massachusetts security deposit law (G.L. c. 186, § 15B) — transfer of interest and vacation rental exemption
requirement: A transferring lessor remains liable for a security deposit until the rental advance is credited to the successor or tenant; the successor assumes liability if the lessor fails to credit it. Lease terms and waivers conflicting with the section are void.
coverage_conditions: Security deposits (rental advances) for rented dwelling units in Massachusetts; the section does not apply to leases of 100 days or less for vacation or recreational purposes.

applicability.per_tenancy: Vacation or recreational leases, rentals, occupancies or tenancies of 100 days or less are exempt; the transfer-liability rule does not apply to a city or town acquiring title under chapter 60 or a foreclosing financial-institution mortgagee.

exemptions: Leases, rentals, occupancies or tenancies of 100 days or less for a vacation or recreational purpose.
quoted_span: In the event that the lessor fails to credit said rental advance to his successor in interest as required by this subsection, the successor in interest shall, without regard to the nature of the transfer, assume liability for crediting of the rental advance, and payment of all interest thereon to the tenant in accordance with the provisions of this section
